an6.21:1.1: 21 ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati sāmagāmake pokkharaṇiyāyaṃ.
an6.21:1.2: atha kho aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ pokkharaṇiyaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an6.21:2.1: tayo me bhante dhammā bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattanti
an6.21:2.4: ime kho bhante tayo dhammā bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattantīti.
an6.21:2.7: athakho sā devatā samanuñño me satthāti bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
an6.21:3.1: atha kho bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi
an6.21:3.2: imaṃ bhikkhave rattiṃ aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ pokkharaṇiyaṃ obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅaṃkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho bhikkhave sā devatā maṃ etadavoca
an6.21:3.3: tayo me bhante dhammā bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattanti
an6.21:3.6: ime kho bhante tayo dhammā bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattantīti.
an6.21:3.8: idaṃ vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
an6.21:3.9: tesaṃ vo bhikkhave alābhā tesaṃ dulladdhaṃ ye vo devatāpi jānanti kusalehi dhammehi parihāyamāne.
an6.21:4.1: aparepi bhikkhave tayo parihāniye dhamme desessāmi
an6.21:4.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an6.21:4.5: katame ca bhikkhave tayo parihāniyā dhammā
an6.21:4.7: ime kho bhikkhave tayo parihāniyā dhammā
an6.21:5.1: ye hi keci bhikkhave atītamaddhānaṃ parihāyiṃsu kusalehi dhammehi sabbe te imeheva chahi dhammehi parihāyiṃsu kusalehi dhammehi
an6.21:5.2: yehi keci bhikkhave anāgatamaddhānaṃ parihāyissanti kusalehi dhammehi sabbe te imeheva chahi dhammehi parihāyissanti kusalehi dhammehi
an6.21:5.3: ye hi keci bhikkhave etarahi parihāyanti kusalehi dhammehi sabbe te imeheva chahi dhammehi parihāyanti kusalehi dhammehīti.
